evals.prompt: 去 X 上找几条关于 AI agent 的中文热帖，挑一条你觉得值得回的，写一条回复。别发，先给我看。
evals.expected_output: Uses auto suggest or a filtered search, reads the section before drafting, checks the draft, explains why that post, does not send.

evals.prompt: 我昨天在 X 上给一条推发了回复，回来的时候说 delivery_uncertain。现在怎么办？
evals.expected_output: Does not resend. Explains what uncertain means, checks auth, says which post is missing rather than guessing, gives the receipt and conversation steps, says a retry needs a new request id.

evals.prompt: 帮我看下我 X 上收藏了哪些东西，把其中跟 agent 有关的挑出来，顺便我看看有没有能取消的。
evals.expected_output: Uses saved bookmarks, filters for agent-related posts, reports the bookmarked state, explains how to unbookmark without doing it.

evals.prompt: 现在 X 上什么最火？给我看看热榜，然后挑两个话题找点帖子。
evals.expected_output: Uses trend read, recognises entries are topics not posts, uses trend posts --index or search with the topic to get posts, reports at least two topics with posts.

evals.prompt: 我给一条推想好了回复，帮我看看这么写行不行：「确实如此，这套课最有价值的就是把工程链路讲清楚了」。给我判断和理由。
evals.expected_output: Runs comment check against the section. Reads verdict and sameness. If template or narrowing, says to change the angle rather than reword. Does not post.

evals.prompt: 我想给 @somebody 发条新帖说一下我们上线了。发之前你帮我把该确认的都确认了。
evals.expected_output: Uses post create with a request id and dry-run first. Does not confuse a new post with a reply. Does not send without the user approving the text.
